description: This file defines the SchedulersJob class, which manages scheduled jobs in SuiteCRM, including job execution, status management, error handling, and related utilities.

classes.name: SchedulersJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job in SuiteCRM, providing methods for job execution, status updates, error handling, and user environment management.

methods.name: check_date_relationships_load
methods.description: Handles date relationship loading, converting execute_time to database format.

methods.name: handleDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a formatted datetime string based on input parameters, considering user time zone and format.

methods.name: fireUrl
methods.description: Performs a cURL request to a specified URL to simulate multi-threaded job execution.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, including job name and job identifier.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Stub for future customization, calls fill_in_additional_detail_fields.

methods.name: failJob
methods.description: Marks the job as failed with an optional message.

methods.name: succeedJob
methods.description: Marks the job as successful with an optional message.

methods.name: onFailureRetry
methods.description: Handles logic when a job fails but is set to retry.

methods.name: onFinalFailure
methods.description: Handles logic when a job has failed and will not be retried.

methods.name: resolveJob
methods.description: Resolves the job as success or failure, manages retries, and updates status.

methods.name: updateSchedulerSuccess
methods.description: Updates the scheduler's last run time upon job success.

methods.name: addMessages
methods.description: Appends error and message strings to the job's message property.

methods.name: postponeJob
methods.description: Reschedules the job to run after a specified delay.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the job record from the database.

methods.name: unexpectedExit
methods.description: Shutdown handler to mark job as failed if it didn't complete properly.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Executes the job based on its target, which can be a function, URL, or class.

methods.name: runJobId
methods.description: Static method to run a job by its ID, with client validation.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles PHP errors during job execution, logs errors.

methods.name: sudo
methods.description: Switches current environment to a specified user.

methods.name: setJobUser
methods.description: Sets the environment to the user assigned to the job.

methods.name: restoreJobUser
methods.description: Restores previous user environment after job execution.
